title: Repeating Patterns
seo_title: Patterns – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Copy, continue and make repeating patterns of colours, shapes and objects; find the missing part and the part that repeats. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: copy, continue and complete repeating patterns of colours and shapes. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Red, blue, red, blue … comes again and again.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Say the pattern out loud.
  • Find the part that comes again and again.
  • Then say what comes next.

Examples

Example

○ △ ○ △ ○ ?

The part that repeats is ○ △

After ○ comes △

Answer: △

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Looking only at the last oneLook at the whole pattern.
Missing an ABB patternSay it: ○ △ △, ○ △ △.
Starting again in the wrong placePoint and say each one.
